findings.evidence: The PR diff replaces `{c : ℝ}` and `Metric.ball x (|c| * r)` with `{c : 𝕜}` and `Metric.ball x (‖c‖ * r)` at the same public theorem name; `rg` confirms the changed declaration is now at line 50.
findings.fix: Keep the existing real `preimage_const_add_smul_ball` statement, and put the generalized normed-field version under a new name, or add an explicit real compatibility theorem for the `|c| * r` form.
findings.issue: `preimage_const_add_smul_ball` changes its public statement from the existing real-scalar radius `|c| * r` to the generic normed-field radius `‖c‖ * r`, so downstream rewrites/applications written against the old theorem no longer match the exposed API.

summary: The new closed-ball and sphere normalizations are plausibly useful, but the PR silently changes an existing public theorem’s real-scalar API. Preserve the old real `|c|` surface or add a compatibility theorem instead of forcing downstream users onto the generalized `‖c‖` statement.
